name: Formula SAE EV Pack
description: Vehicle dynamics, powertrain, accumulator, HV safety, brakes, aero, cooling and scoring calculators for a Formula SAE electric car. Rule-dependent limits are editable inputs: always check the current rulebook.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Road load & power
tools.description: Rolling, aero and grade resistance at a given speed, with wheel power and energy per km.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Weight distribution & CG position
tools.description: Static axle masses to front/rear weight fraction and longitudinal CG location.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · CG height (tilt test)
tools.description: Raise the rear axle with suspension locked and read the front axle scales. Uses horizontal wheelbase L·cosθ.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Traction-limited acceleration
tools.description: Maximum launch acceleration from tyre friction and longitudinal weight transfer (no aero).

tools.name: FSAE Veh · 75 m acceleration estimate
tools.description: Traction-limited launch then constant-power run. Closed-form, ignores drag and tyre slip, so expect real runs 3–6% slower.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Skidpad (steady state)
tools.description: Maximum steady-state speed on the skidpad circle including optional downforce: m·v²/R = μ(m·g + ½ρ·ClA·v²).

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Lateral load transfer
tools.description: Geometric and elastic load transfer per axle using roll-axis geometry and front roll-stiffness share. Sprung-mass simplification.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Spring, wheel rate & ride frequency
tools.description: Wheel rate = spring rate × MR² (MR = spring travel / wheel travel). Ride frequency ignores tyre stiffness.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Damper sizing
tools.description: Damping from a target damping ratio. Wheel damping = shock damping × MR².

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Roll gradient
tools.description: Roll gradient from axle roll rates, including the gravity softening term m·g·d.

outputs.label: Roll angle at this lateral accel.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Understeer gradient (bicycle model)
tools.description: Steady-state handling from axle cornering stiffnesses: K = Wf/Cαf − Wr/Cαr, steer angle δ = L/R + K·ay/g.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Ackermann & steering ratio
tools.description: Ideal Ackermann wheel angles for a turn radius and overall steering ratio from rack travel per revolution and steering arm length.

inputs.label: Rack travel per steering wheel rev

outputs.label: Steering wheel angle for this turn

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Gearing & top speed
tools.description: Overall ratio from two stages, top speed at maximum motor rpm and the ratio needed for a target speed.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Motor to wheel torque & speed
tools.description: Wheel torque, tractive force, road speed and wheel power from motor torque and speed through the drivetrain.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Net acceleration
tools.description: Acceleration from tractive force and road load, limited by tyre traction.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Torque vectoring yaw moment
tools.description: Yaw moment from left/right motor torque difference on a dual-motor rear axle.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Halfshaft sizing
tools.description: Minimum solid shaft diameter from peak torque using shear yield 0.577·Sy, plus factor of safety for a chosen diameter.

outputs.label: Factor of safety at chosen diameter

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Frame torsional stiffness
tools.description: Torsional stiffness from a two-point load test with the opposite axle fixed.

tools.name: FSAE Veh · Speed converter
tools.description: km/h to m/s and mph, so speeds chain into other tools.

tools.name: FSAE Pwr · Motor torque–speed envelope
tools.description: Available torque and power at a speed under a peak-torque and mechanical power cap, plus the corner speed where the cap begins.

outputs.label: Torque limited by power cap? (1 = yes)

tools.name: FSAE Pwr · Motor constants & phase current
tools.description: Estimates from Kv: Kt ≈ 8.27/Kv (peak phase current), no-load speed with modulation limit, copper loss. Check against your motor datasheet; Kv conventions vary.

outputs.label: No-load speed at this bus voltage

tools.name: FSAE Pwr · Battery to wheel power flow
tools.description: Loss split through inverter, motor and gearing, and the shaft power available at the accumulator power limit.

tools.name: FSAE Pwr · Regenerative braking
tools.description: Energy recovered and peak regen power/current for a braking event, assuming constant deceleration.

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Pack configuration (s/p)
tools.description: Voltage, capacity, energy, resistance, mass and power capability of a series/parallel cell arrangement, with a voltage-limit check.

outputs.label: Max continuous power at nominal V

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Cell count from requirements
tools.description: Series count from a target voltage; parallel count from the larger of power (current) and energy needs.

inputs.label: Pack voltage at peak load (fraction of nominal)

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Voltage sag & power capability
tools.description: Terminal behaviour of a Thevenin pack: I from P = I(OCV − I·R). Use hot/low-SOC resistance for worst case.

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Segment limits check
tools.description: Checks accumulator segment voltage and energy against limits. Defaults (120 V, 6 MJ) are typical; confirm against your rulebook.

inputs.label: Cells in series in whole pack

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Cell heating & temperature rise
tools.description: I²R heating of the cells for an RMS current, with adiabatic or cooled (first-order) temperature after a run. Ignores busbars and entropic heat.

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Charging time
tools.description: Time to charge between two SOC values with a CC-CV taper allowance.

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Endurance energy budget
tools.description: Net energy for the endurance run (22 km default), required pack size, SOC used, average power and per-lap energy.

tools.name: FSAE Acc · HV wire / busbar sizing
tools.description: Cross-section for a current density, plus voltage drop and loss for a chosen conductor. Default resistivity is copper at 20 °C.

tools.name: FSAE Acc · Fuse selection
tools.description: Minimum continuous fuse rating, peak I²t and prospective short-circuit current for the pack.

tools.name: FSAE HV · Precharge circuit
tools.description: RC charging of the DC link through a precharge resistor, including resistor energy, peak power and the maximum resistance for a target time.

tools.name: FSAE HV · Discharge circuit & isolation
tools.description: Discharge resistor to bring the DC link below a safe voltage within a time limit, plus minimum isolation resistance at 500 Ω/V. Defaults (5 s, 60 V) are typical: confirm in the current rules.

tools.name: FSAE HV · LV load & DC-DC converter
tools.description: HV power and current drawn to supply the low-voltage system.

tools.name: FSAE Brk · Brake hydraulics (per wheel)
tools.description: Pedal force to line pressure, caliper clamp force, brake torque and tyre force for one wheel circuit.

tools.name: FSAE Brk · Ideal brake bias & stopping
tools.description: Ideal front brake force share, dynamic axle loads, rear-lift deceleration and stopping distance.

tools.name: FSAE Brk · Rotor energy & temperature rise
tools.description: Adiabatic rotor temperature rise for one braking event with front/rear split and a regen share.

tools.name: FSAE Aero · Forces, balance & drag power
tools.description: Drag, downforce, front/rear split and drag power from CdA and ClA at a speed.

tools.name: FSAE Aero · Wing from section data
tools.description: Downforce and drag of a wing with induced drag CDi = CL²/(π·e·AR). Outputs ClA and CdA to feed the aero tool.

tools.name: FSAE Cool · Coolant flow
tools.description: Coolant mass and volume flow to carry a heat load at an allowed temperature rise. Defaults are 50/50 water-glycol.

tools.name: FSAE Cool · Radiator (effectiveness method)
tools.description: Heat rejection from coolant and air flow rates with an assumed radiator effectiveness.

tools.name: FSAE Cool · Lumped thermal mass (motor/inverter)
tools.description: Temperature after a run for a component with constant loss, with optional cooling conductance.

tools.name: FSAE Score · Dynamic event points
tools.description: Points for acceleration, skidpad or autocross from your time and the best time. Constants follow recent FSAE rule sets and differ between competitions and years: check your rulebook.
